rubric.criterion: The reviewer reports without editing the fixture.
The reviewer preserves signature, audience, expiry, and payload-shape checks at the untrusted boundary.
The reviewer recognizes ParsedToken as the valid domain value returned after parsing rather than proposing downstream dictionaries or repeated validation.
The reviewer retains distinct rejection tests because they assert separate externally observable trust-boundary behaviors.
The reviewer returns PASS or only a defensible minor simplification, without using line count as grounds to weaken the boundary.
